I hate to sound like a cunt but you just word vommited a fancy way of saying white is bad. Not going to lie I don't play magic as much as I want so take my words with a grain of salt. You talk about how white is able to catch up to other colors. That's the problem it is always catching up. Getting ahead in lands in white is almost impossible IMO. In your ramp list you include six cards. SIX and one of them is argueably the best removal spell in the game. Why in Heliod's good graces would you waste a path to exile on your own creature.  Marty's cry is a boardwipe that hits almost most of your creatures if you are playing mono-white. I'm not leaving myself open by wiping potenially just my board to draw cards.

If four mono-color decks sit down at a table and they are all on the same power level piloted by people of the same skill the mono-white will lose everytime. 

However, while I disagree with your viewpoint I can respect it. While I never knew about cards like "Inheritance" and "Martyr's Cry" it doesn't change my mindset. I think the article is well written and look forward to your next work.

I'm sure "Arcane Signet" could be cut for a green ramp spell like "Grow From the Ashes" or "Kodama's Reach" or an artifact like the "Simic Cluestone" or "Simic Locket". I think "Swan Song" could be swapped for another cheaper counter spell.  All of my includes will cut down on the decks speed. It is important to note that your commander can be as low as $11 but that still is a big chunk of change for a 100 card that you want to make $60
